parts.name: mitochondrion
parts.hint: The bean-shaped powerhouse that releases energy from food.

parts.name: chloroplast
parts.hint: The green packet that traps sunlight to make food.

parts.name: vacuole
parts.hint: The big sap-filled bag that keeps this cell firm.

parts.name: nucleolus
parts.hint: The dark spot deep inside the control room where ribosomes are made.

parts.name: nucleus
parts.hint: The control room that stores the cell's instructions.

parts.name: nuclear envelope
parts.hint: The double skin around the control room, with gaps to let messages out.

parts.name: vesicle
parts.hint: A small bubble pinched off to carry goods around the cell.

parts.name: Golgi apparatus
parts.hint: The stack of sacs that packages and posts what the cell makes.

parts.name: smooth endoplasmic reticulum
parts.hint: The smooth tubes that make fats and store them.

parts.name: rough endoplasmic reticulum
parts.hint: The folded sheets studded with grains that build proteins.

parts.name: cytoplasm
parts.hint: The jelly that fills the cell and holds everything in place.

parts.name: cell membrane
parts.hint: The thin skin just inside the stiff jacket, letting things in and out.

parts.name: cell wall
parts.hint: The stiff outer jacket that gives this cell its box shape.
